user.title: Sign in to GKP Home
user.description: Sign in with your GKP Home account. Your password is used once to sign in and is not stored.

data_description.email: The email address of your GKP Home account.
data_description.password: Your GKP Home password. It is only used to sign in and is not stored.

api_credentials.name: API credentials (advanced)
api_credentials.description: The values the GKP Home app uses to talk to the cloud. They are built into this integration; only fill these in if they have changed.

data_description.client_secret: The OAuth client secret of the GKP Home app. Leave empty to use the built-in value.
data_description.apim_key: The API subscription key (Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key) of the GKP Home app. Leave empty to use the built-in value.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to GKP Home again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for {email} is no longer valid. Enter your password to sign in again.

data_description.password: Your GKP Home password. It is only used to sign in and is not stored.

api_credentials.name: API credentials (advanced)
api_credentials.description: The values the GKP Home app uses to talk to the cloud. Only fill these in if they have changed.

data_description.client_secret: The OAuth client secret of the GKP Home app. Leave empty to keep the current value.
data_description.apim_key: The API subscription key (Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key) of the GKP Home app. Leave empty to keep the current value.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid authentication. Check your email and password. If signing in recently stopped working for everyone, the GKP Home app's API credentials may have changed; update the integration.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the GKP Home cloud.

abort.already_configured: This GKP Home account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The account you signed in to is not the account this entry was created with.

data_description.poll_interval: How often the radiators are read from the cloud, in seconds (minimum 30).

write_failed.message: Could not send the command to the radiator: {error}

auth_failed.message: GKP Home rejected the saved session. Sign in again from the integration page.
